completed: Agent development, evidence and bounded reviews

results.title: Agent development, evidence and bounded reviews
results.summary: Implemented the remaining Phase 4 boundary fixes around published voice snapshots, authorized context mutations, domain angle invalidation, targeted recheck/release readiness, restartable reviews, and stricter prompt validation coverage. — Cycle 3 review found the prior blocking issues addressed: successor activities and reconciliation are now persisted within the transaction before after-commit dispatch, draft write permission is revalidated before paid work, and completed draft reuse is tied to the active plan approval with restart support. The required Livewire denial/stale/angle-regression coverage is present, so this phase is ready to commit from the reviewed diff.

results.title: Release delivery and public cutover
results.summary: Review FAILED after 3 cycle(s) with 1 blocking finding(s). Headless runs do not commit at the cycle cap; changes left unstaged.
findings: high/spec-deviation app/Actions/Publishing/CheckArticleRelease.php:126 — Readiness staleness only tracks max finding/activity IDs and omits current evidence-manifest hashes and existing review/disposition data, so evidence hash or disposition changes after package preparation can still pass approval/delivery despite the spec requiring frozen evidence/review inputs to invalidate the package → Include hashed evidence manifests and review/disposition identifiers/hashes in the readiness input hash, recheck them before approval/delivery, and add stale-evidence/disposition tests

medium/spec-deviation resources/views/components/admin/publishing/⚡article-workspace.blade.php:211 — Scheduled release intent records only config('app.timezone') after parsing the freeform time with server defaults, so it does not persist/display the owner's selected zone and offset as required → Capture an explicit timezone/offset in the schedule confirmation payload and cover it in ReleaseIntegrity tests
